scope: controlled same-process loopback; probe is not formal performance

metric_definitions.rpc_after_fault_ms: T0 to this original Worker RPC exit, not Gateway session exit
metric_definitions.rpc_after_return_ms: nonnegative Worker RPC exit minus its own client return; later failure can shorten this without earlier release
metric_definitions.rpc_seconds_after_fault: sum of original RPC lifetimes after T0; not CPU seconds
metric_definitions.latency_population: complete sessions only; independent batches are not paired patients
metric_definitions.remote_idle_after_return_ms: whole-batch natural idle minus this client return
metric_definitions.completion_rate_bounds: verified complete/planned to (verified complete+unknown)/planned; unavailable for corrupt archive
